triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER order_timestamp_number BEFORE INSERT ON "order" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION assign_timestamp_order_number()
triggers.function_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.assign_timestamp_order_number()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
      DECLARE
        tick bigint;
      BEGIN
        UPDATE "order_number_clock"
        SET last_tick = GREATEST(
          last_tick + 1,
          floor(extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp()) * 100000)::bigint
        )
        WHERE id = true
        RETURNING last_tick INTO STRICT tick;

        NEW.custom_display_id :=
          to_char(to_timestamp((tick / 100000)::double precision)
            AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
          || lpad((tick % 100000)::text, 5, '0');
        RETURN NEW;
      END;
      $function$
